pages.text: At the bottom right corner of the screen there are three bars which display the amount of energy you have in a given system(cultivation type). $(br)If combat mode is enabled a sword will apear below the energy bars. Combat mode allows you to cast skills and apply the strength stat to melee attacks. Combat mode also has a visual aura indicator at higher stages

pages.title: Key Mappings
pages.text: Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.introspection) to open the Introspection Menu. $(br)Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.meditate) to Meditate in order to do cultivation stuff. $(br)Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.exercise) to exercise and body cultivate. $(br)Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.cast_skill) to cast a skill when in combat mode. $(br)Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.combat_mode) to toggle combat mode. $(br)Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.divine_sense) to Activate Divine Sense. $(br)Press $(k:wuxiacraft.key.skill_wheel) to open up skill wheel when in combat mode.

The easiest way to start is to find a village and a technique store and then trade with the villager to get a manual. If there is no technique store craft a technique inscriber and assign a villager to it. Right click the manual to learn it's aspects then shift-right click the technique inscriber to copy down the manual to your grid. Depending on the type of manual and it's cultivation type, cultivate acordingly.
